Name: Node_Rome_Room
Line: They have asked me again. Rufus and the others -- they want it written down while there is still someone to ask. I have told them what I think of books. A book cannot be questioned. You put a thing on a page and it stops being something a man has to stand behind.

Options.PlayerLine: Then stand behind it. I will write what you say and nothing you do not.
There is no one left to ask. That is what they are telling you, and they are right.
Then I will come back when you have decided.

Name: Node_Rome_NotHere
Line: Not out here. Half this quarter is watching the other half for the reward, and I am no use to anyone burned. Find me where the door shuts.

Name: Node_Peter_Terms
Line: Then we do it my way. I will tell it as I have always told it -- the way it comes out when I am speaking to people who need to hear it, not the way a Greek would arrange it for a shelf. If you start tidying me, I stop.

Options.PlayerLine: Tell it however it comes. I will keep the order you give it.
It would carry further if it ran in sequence. Men trust a thing that runs in sequence.
There is a collection of the sayings going round, in the dialect. Should I follow its shape?

Name: Node_Peter_NotInOrder
Line: Sequence. I was there, and I cannot give you sequence. Some days there were crowds and some days there were not, and what I have kept is the order it is useful in, not the order the sun came up in. If you want a man who can put it all in a line, go and find one who was not there.

Options.PlayerLine: Then I will write it out of order and say so.

Name: Node_Peter_Sayings
Line: Matthew's people have their collection and it is a good one, but it is sayings. A saying with nothing round it can be made to mean anything by the next man who picks it up. I want what happened round them. Where he was standing, and who was arguing with him, and what it cost.

Options.PlayerLine: Then narrative, not sayings. Go on.

Name: Node_Peter_Dictates
Line: Start where it starts. No line of descent, no childhood -- begin at the river, with John, because that is where any of us first laid eyes on him. Everything before that is somebody else's to tell and I was not there for it.

Options.PlayerLine: The Greeks will want a beginning. A birth, a lineage, something to place him.
You come off badly in this. The night in the courtyard -- you want that in?
Others have told me the women found the tomb first. Does that stand?
Enough for tonight. My hand is finished.

Name: Node_Peter_NoBeginning
Line: Let them want it. I did not meet him as a child and I will not put my name to a childhood I did not see. If somebody else can get that from his mother's people, let them write it and let it stand next to this one.

Name: Node_Peter_OwnName
Line: It happened. If I cut that out, what else comes out with it? Half the men I am telling this for were in this city when I arrived and they have heard me say it against myself for twenty years. Leave it in. Let it stand as it stands, and if I sound like a fool in it, that is because I was one.

Name: Node_Peter_Women
Line: It stands. And before you ask -- no, we did not believe them, and you can put that down too. We had to go and look for ourselves, which is exactly the sort of thing a man leaves out when he is building something. I am not building anything. I am telling you what the morning was like.

Options.PlayerLine: Both parts, then. Theirs and yours.

Name: Node_Peter_Begins
Line: Then get it down. Not tonight -- my voice is gone and your hand is worse. But get it down, and when it is finished you will read the whole of it back to me, and I will tell you every place you have made me sound better than I was.

Options.PlayerLine: Every place. I will keep the list.
